title: UserAppInfo - Data API
description: Stores the last Lightning app logged in to. If the user hasn’t logged into Salesforce or if the user lost access to the last accessed app, the UserAppInfo object stores a Null value. This object is available in API version 38.0 and later.

AppDefinitionId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AppDefinitionId.description: The ID of the last Lightning app that the user logged in to. This field is available in API version 43.0 and later. This is a relationship field.

FormFactor.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
FormFactor.description: The relative size of the app as displayed. Values are: Small—suitable for a small device like a mobile phone Medium—suitable for a tablet Large—suitable for a large display device, like a monitor It’s possible to have three versions of the app as the one last logged in to, where each version has a different form factor.

UserId.description: The ID of the user that used this app. This is a relationship field.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **UserAppInfoChangeEvent (API version 62.0)**: Change events are available for the object.
